data_source: Kaggle Favorita Store Sales (train.csv, test.csv promotions, holidays_events.csv, stores.csv)
granularity: store x food family x day
ordering_cycle: weekly, Wednesday; features use only sales up to the day before the origin

routing.cold_start: < 56 trading days at the order date -> same weekday last week (+/-30% band)
routing.intermittent: >= 50% zero-sales days in last 28 while the store was open >= 80% of them -> LightGBM, flagged low reliability (TSB tested in backtest and not better)

forecast_schema.forecast_origin: Wednesday the order is placed (first forecast day)
forecast_schema.route: lightgbm | cold_start (<56 trading days: same weekday last week) | intermittent (sparse demand in an open store: low reliability flag)
forecast_schema.onpromotion: planned number of promoted items (from the promotion calendar)
forecast_schema.p50: median demand forecast (units) - use as the point forecast
forecast_schema.p90: 90th percentile of demand (units) - use for safety stock / service level

known_limitations: Inventory, lead time, shelf life and MOQ are simulated downstream; the model only forecasts demand.
Promotion counts are assumed known in advance (retailer promotion calendar / Kaggle test.csv).
Granularity is product family, not SKU.
Unforeseen shocks (e.g. the 2016 earthquake) are not predictable from history; see stress-test window.
